scope: Adopt direct VIN enable for the always-on LM61460AANRJRR SoM supply on both boards; integrated native qualification, not fabrication readiness

hardware_decision.change: Connect U4.7 EN/SYNC to the same +VIN_SYS net as VIN1/VIN2 pins 8/12. Remove inherited TPS54302-era R12/D5/C20 clamp/filter and their obsolete value bindings and proximity structure. All other power-stage connectivity and physical limits retained.
hardware_decision.tradeoff: External RC delay/filter is removed intentionally. No external enable-delay requirement was identified. Input decoupling and internal UVLO/soft-start remain. Direct self-start is manufacturer-supported; this is not proof of input-envelope, startup-time or transient margins.
hardware_decision.check_meaning: Unique pin ownership and exact supported topology only, explicitly separated from analog measurements in test plans. Unsupported historical enable networks remain UNVERIFIED.

tests.historical_fixtures: Immutable originals retained. Only the exact retired component bindings and obsolete enable rows receive explicit, counted test-view exceptions; production results are never restored to old PASS rows.
tests.additional: Both-board live geometry/publication tests and schematic template/connectivity regression tests passed in the preceding two commits.

visual_review: Eight 3D views produced per board; front/back inspected on both, changed carrier power_som schematic inspected. SoM top keepout, perimeter connector access and mounting holes remain visually clear; no inference that unused bottom area is automatically legal for arbitrary parts.
timing_limits: Runs overlapped each other and targeted tests on the same host. These are qualification observations, not isolated performance benchmarks. Compile time was not measured for this change. Mixed sheet rendering/check stages are not mislabeled generation-only. No new Python speedup claim; matched comparison against 0e9bbc913bab77f9cd228940db2a332d25d6bfa1 remains outstanding.
residuals: Existing advisory return_path, golden and contract_coverage_lint failures remain on both boards; none waived or blessed.
Devkit manual/scfw explicitly SKIP absent carrier-only features under existing policy.
Board dimensions unchanged; three fewer parts per board, not a newly smaller accepted outline.
Routing remains out of scope; unrouted connections are retained explicitly.
Input envelope, startup/transient margins, assembly/height and thermal model assumptions remain separate qualification obligations; no fabrication-readiness claim.
Goal incomplete: broader algorithms, smaller hardware-safe carrier and matched historical timings still require work.
